about: Unity Unicorn's parts of the lights on Unity Stable's page (Astra, 2026-11-13: these belong to Unity Unicorn, not to Inference Iguana). Inference Iguana's Benchmark Rock reads this file from the folder next to its own: when Unity's red light is pressed it runs the opener script below instead of opening Unity on its own.

cannot_open.unity-mcp: It runs inside the Unity editor (Window, MCP for Unity), so it starts when Unity opens a project that has it: press Unity's light instead.
